request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We let flats and want to avoid tenants from age groups with high rates of mental illness; the figures tell us whom to turn down.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised encounters for patients with COPD aged 40 or older.
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Cohort = patients with COPD aged 40 or older on 31 December 2025.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
